Katana only Type Active, Physical skill Element Weapon Dependent MP 500 $result_string .= sprintf("Aggro %s", $row['aggro_text']); Combo start Yes Combo middle Yes Range 2 Description The ultimate slash. The power increases every time you use certain Mononofu Skills. ( 10 Times at Most ) Power increases against targets inflicted with [Armor Break]. Critical Rate is extremely low. Katana The power of Mononofu skills increases as Garyou Tensei's buff increases. Upon skill activation, all accumulated Garyou Tensei's buff will be consumed and you will enter a damage reduction state. During this state, the power of Mononofu skills will remain at maximum. It will be reset when "Gust" ends. Extras Show more...
